_rule: Prepared BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). STAGED, not queued, not authorized. One Water Queens House (S8) launch with the hs1 set plus rt_hair_mv_card=1 at startup (specialization 1049 compiled into the velocity variant), the hs1 lowered view, then a static camera with the party idling (hs1 bursts: hair-adjacent pixels move 0.1-0.7 px/frame). Four K8 edge bursts with RR's motion vectors (pan_edge=1, pan_mvec=1: half-size depth, final, rr_mvec every frame, material frames 1 and 8): strands at rt_hair_mv_card 0, 1, 2 and cards. Analysis: py -3 tools/hair_groom/mv_ratio.py <mv0> <mv1> <mv2> <cards> --labels mv0,mv1,mv2,cards.
observable: Which path leaves strand pixels with the camera-only motion: the share of class-5 pixels within 0.02 px of the static background motion and the hair / ring median |mv| ratio, per key value, against the cards of the same run.

mechanism (counter line, every window).line: [hair groom] strand motion (last N frames): keyed groom rows R, with previous points P, without W (first update, two updates in one build frame, skipped build frames); publishes, without the previous camera ...
mechanism (counter line, every window).predicted: W / R under 5% and publishes without the previous camera 0 at the idle static camera (hl1/hs1: one publish per frame, 'recovered 0'); then row.w 0 is NOT the main cause and mv_card=1 changes nothing measurable
mechanism (counter line, every window).decides_rows_if: W / R >= 50% in the static windows: the previous points are missing (M1 gate), mv_card=1 is the fix; report the dominant reason

motion vectors.predicted_mv1: as mv0 within 0.05 (the counter line shows rows without previous points under 5%: the M1 fallback is not the cause)
motion vectors.predicted_mv2: camera-only share <= 0.15, ratio 0.5-1.1, as the cards (hs1 cards: 0.055-0.068, 0.52-1.08): mode 2 writes before every strand check
motion vectors.decides_discard_if: mv2 near the cards while mv1 stays near mv0: a check of the strand path (seal/tag, accepted marker, ownership, segment) discards; mode 2 is the fix, the discard counter names the check
motion vectors.decides_depth_if: mv2 also stays camera-only: the velocity fragment never passes (depth test against the stored strand depth, or the draw is not the swapped one); next: the velocity pipeline's depth/stencil state line and a depth readback at strand pixels

invalid_if: any burst without '[pan] burst <serial> complete: 8 frames, ... transport ok'
no '[hair groom] strand motion' line in a settle window
hair region < 500 half-size px in a burst
ring median |mv| < 0.05 px in every burst (the party did not move: no signal; rerun later in the session, not a new tool)
cost: report only: '[hair primary] strand G-buffer draws GPU' ms in the mv0 and mv2 windows (the card path skips two point loads: equal or lower)
disk: 4 K8 edge bursts x ~0.1 GB = ~0.4 GB; deleted after mv_ratio.py, summaries kept
energy: final mean over the class-5 pixels of frames 1 and 8: mv2 within 1% of mv0 (reconstruction rule); the mean over 8 frames of the whole hair box too
